page.layout: One printed page (p. 240) of running text, one column, with running head at top. No marginal notes. At the far right edge a sliver of the neighbouring page shows, which is not transcribed. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.l: Christi Praxin imponi curat, etsi à Deo minime
jussam, prout Ipsi visum est. Quinetiam, Invocati-
onem hanc Exigit ab iis, qui haud certi sunt,
utrum Christus Nobis fuerit in Servatorem à Pa-
tre datus, annon? Quasi Oratio accepta esse possit
sine Fide; aut Fides non praesupponat cognitionem
illius Numinis, ad quod preces nostras dirigimus,
aut, denique, quasi salutem ab eo rite poscere quae-
amus, de quo dubii sumus, an Talis sit, qui nobis
salutem istam conferre possi-
t.
§. 90. Ita tergiversatur Socinus, ita Subterfugia
quaerit, ita totam Antiquitatem aut calumniatur
aut contemnit, dum suo Dogmati patrocinium un-
diquaque petit. Quod malae Causae maximum Indi-
cium est. Neque hoc ei Proprium fuit. Idem enim
factitatum legimus à senioribus Anti-Trinitariis, quo-
rum Socinus, ut in Doctrina, sic in moribus videtur
fuisse Discipulus. Siquidem accepimus primarios quos-
dam ex horum numero, tam Polonos, quam exte-
ros, qui post Servetum Genevae combustum, in par-
tes Transylvaniae & Poloniae certatim confugerant,
haeresesque suas illic disseminare caeperant, quam-
primum innotuere Ecclesiis Evangelicis & malesa-
nae fuerunt Doctrinae sic ab iis traditae, comperti fu-
erint, haeretica sua Dogmata dissimulasse tamen,
fidemque orthodoxam palam professos fuisse, quo-
ties in Synodos citabantur, ad respondendum de
suspicione haereseos. Ita Petrus Statorius Thionvil-
anus, in Synodum Pinczoviensem citatus, hanc
suam Confessionem edidit, propriaque manu con-
fignavit. A. D. 1559.—Prophetiam & Apostolicam

page.notes: Printed "s" and "ff" forms were read as plain s: "jussam" (printed juffam), "visum" (printed vifum), "Christi" (printed Chrifti), "Amplector" (printed Ampleftor), "Pinczoviensem". Running head word "sana" is doubtful (the scan shows "De sana" or similar). Catchword "ritum" is read from a small fragment at lower right. Faint ink at lower left and the neighbouring page's edge at right were not transcribed. Ligature "st" and "ct" forms were read as "st" and "ct".
